summary: Connect programs to organizational goals with practical alignment, benefits, and portfolio tools. Explore this 5-day intermediate course.
lede: Program alignment connects organizational goals with funded initiatives and measurable benefits. For program managers, portfolio analysts, and strategy execution professionals, this training supports assessing whether proposals advance strategic objectives and making investment trade-offs visible. You’ll practise translating goals into strategy maps, defining benefits and measures, mapping dependencies, prioritizing programs, and preparing performance dashboards for governance and portfolio reviews.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who translate organizational strategy into coordinated programs, investment choices, benefit measures, and executive reporting.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with organizational objectives, programs, projects, or portfolio review processes is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Advanced analytics and AI-assisted portfolio analysis receive conceptual and operational-awareness treatment; the practical exercises use Excel-based templates.
